description: Implementation of SmsReadPlatformService for reading SMS message data from the database, including methods for retrieving all messages, specific messages by ID, and messages filtered by status, campaign, and date range.

classes.name: SmsMapper
classes.description: RowMapper implementation for mapping SQL result set rows to SmsData objects.

classes.name: SmsReadPlatformServiceImpl
classes.description: Service class providing methods to read SMS message data from the database.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the SmsMapper instance after construction.

methods.name: retrieveAll
methods.description: Retrieves all SMS messages from the database.

methods.name: retrieveOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific SMS message by its ID.

methods.name: retrieveAllPending
methods.description: Retrieves all pending SMS messages, optionally filtered by campaign ID and limited in number.

methods.name: retrieveAllSent
methods.description: Retrieves all sent SMS messages, limited in number.

methods.name: retrieveExternalIdsOfAllSent
methods.description: Retrieves external IDs of all sent SMS messages, limited in number.

methods.name: retrieveAllWaitingForDeliveryReport
methods.description: Retrieves a page of SMS message IDs waiting for delivery reports.

methods.name: retrieveAllPending
methods.description: Retrieves external IDs of all pending SMS messages, limited in number.

methods.name: retrieveAllDelivered
methods.description: Retrieves all delivered SMS messages, limited in number.

methods.name: retrieveAllFailed
methods.description: Retrieves all failed SMS messages, limited in number.

methods.name: retrieveSmsByStatus
methods.description: Retrieves SMS messages filtered by campaign, status, and date range with pagination and sorting.
